# TruthLens

> TruthLens is a food label scanner. You photograph the nutrition table on a packaged food, and it tells you how many grams are safe to eat today, based on WHO daily limits.

## What it checks
- Sugar: 25 g per day (WHO, under 5% of energy on 2,000 kcal)
- Saturated fat: 22 g per day (WHO, under 10% of energy on 2,000 kcal)
- Trans fat: about 2.2 g per day (WHO, under 1% of energy)
- Total fat: about 67 g per day (WHO, 30% of energy)
- Sodium: under 2,000 mg per day (WHO, about 5 g salt)
- Safe grams = daily limit / (nutrient per 100 g / 100). The smallest result is the limiting nutrient.

## Plans
- Free: 10 scans per account. A paid plan is planned.

## Important
- General nutrition guidance, not medical advice.
- Label values have tolerances of about 20%, so results are estimates.
